answer.reason: The verses tell of Silas's sending to Antioch with the letter, his chosen journey with Paul, and his imprisonment at Philippi.

clauses.english: was sent with Paul and Barnabas to Antioch to carry the apostles' letter to the Gentile brethren
clauses.quote: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.

clauses.english: was chosen by Paul to travel with him, confirming the churches
clauses.quote: And Paul chose Silas, and departed

clauses.english: was beaten and imprisoned at Philippi, and sang praises to God at midnight
clauses.quote: at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God

doubts: The verses naming Silvanus (2CO 1:19, 1TH 1:1, 2TH 1:1, 1PE 5:12) were left out because they do not state that Silvanus is the same man as Silas.
